annotations.title: Get a file from a link

description:
Fetch a link and return a download URL, in one call. A Quark, PikPak or Baidu share with folders or
        several files answers status "pick_required" with a `share_id` and its files: call again with `share_id`
        and the `file_id` of a file, one call per file (open folders with `list_files`).

        Waits up to `wait_seconds` (at most 20 s) for the file to be ready. If it is not ready yet, the result has
        status "queued" or "running", a `job_id` and `next_step`: call `get_job` with `wait_seconds` 20 until it has
        succeeded, then `get_download_link`. The same link asked again while its job is on its way returns that job.

        A social media post link (X, Douyin, Xiaohongshu, Instagram) is answered as `download_social` answers.

        Docs: https://fetchpan.com/mcp-server

file_id.description: The id of the one file to download, from the share's list
file_id.title: File Id

share_id.description: From a pick_required answer: the share the file is in
share_id.title: Share Id

url.description: Share or file link from a supported site
url.title: Url

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the file to be ready (at most 20 s are used)
wait_seconds.title: Wait Seconds
